Privacy Policy meta description: Privacy Policy and information about cookies and personal data processing on this website.
Privacy Policy building notice: This page is still being built and updated. Some information may be incomplete or may change as the website develops.
Privacy Policy introduction: This Privacy Policy explains in simple terms how this personal website handles personal data, cookies and information provided by visitors and users.
Privacy Policy operator: This website is operated by Nikita Nekhay as a personal website. There is currently no registered company or other legal entity operating this website.
Privacy Policy personal website: The website may provide personal, creative, portfolio, account and online shopping functionality.
Privacy Policy contact text: For questions about privacy or personal data, please contact:
Personal data introduction: Personal data is collected only when you voluntarily provide it, for example when creating an account, updating your profile, contacting the website or placing an order.
Account data description: When you create an account, the website may process information needed to create and maintain your account.
Account data profile: Other information that you voluntarily add to your profile
Order data description: When you place an order, the website may process the information necessary to identify you, communicate with you and complete the order.
Order data contact: Name and contact details provided for the order
Order data delivery: Delivery information, including country, city and address when required
Order data cart: Information about the products included in your shopping cart or order
Order data communication: Messages or other information you provide in connection with the order
Payment data statement: The website does not collect or store payment card details. Payment information is handled by the relevant payment provider where applicable.
Technical data description: The website and its third-party services may process technical information such as IP address, browser type, device information, approximate location, operating system, request information and information about how the website is accessed. The exact data depends on the service being used.
Purposes introduction: Personal data and technical information may be processed for the following purposes:
Purpose account: Creating, maintaining and securing user accounts
Purpose communication: Communicating with users about accounts, orders, requests or other website-related matters
Purpose security: Preventing abuse, fraud, unauthorized access and other security problems
Purpose analytics: Understanding website usage and improving website performance and content
Purpose site operation: Operating, maintaining and improving the website and its technical infrastructure
Purpose limitation: Personal data is not intentionally collected for purposes unrelated to the operation of the website or the services requested by the user.
Cookies introduction: Cookies are small files or similar technologies stored in a browser or device. This website uses necessary cookies for basic functionality and consent management. Some third-party services used by the website may also place their own cookies or use similar browser storage technologies.
Necessary cookies description: The website uses the necessary cookie named nekhay_gdpr to remember the visitor's cookie consent choice. This cookie is required for the cookie-consent mechanism and cannot be disabled through the consent banner.
Analytics cookies description: Google Analytics and Yandex Metrica are used on the website for analytics and website usage measurement. These services may use cookies or similar technologies to collect information about visits and interactions with the website.
Analytics cookies review: Analytics technologies should be used only in accordance with the consent and configuration mechanisms implemented on the website. The website owner may change or disable these technologies in the future.
Cookie consent storage: Stores the visitor's cookie consent choice.
Google Analytics cookie: Used by Google Analytics to distinguish users and measure website usage.
Google Analytics session information: Used by Google Analytics to store information related to analytics sessions and measurements.
Google third party cookies: Google may set additional cookies on Google-owned domains when Google services are used. Their exact names, purposes and retention periods may depend on the service and browser context.
Browser storage description: The website may also use browser storage technologies such as localStorage or sessionStorage for functional purposes. These technologies are not necessarily cookies but can store information in the user's browser.
Cookie changes statement: The list and configuration of cookies may change when website functionality or third-party services change.
Third party introduction: The website uses or may use third-party services to provide functionality, authentication, analytics, security and technical infrastructure. These services may process information according to their own privacy policies.
Firebase Authentication description: Used to provide user registration, login and authentication functionality.
Firebase Firestore description: Used to store application and user-related data required for website functionality.
Google Analytics description: Used to measure website traffic and understand how visitors use the website.
Google Tag Manager description: Used to manage website tags and scripts. Tags configured through this service may process information according to their individual purposes.
Yandex Metrica description: Used for website analytics, traffic measurement and understanding user interactions.
Vercel Speed Insights description: Used to measure website performance and help improve the technical performance of the website.
reCAPTCHA description: Used to help protect forms or other functionality from automated abuse and malicious activity.
Third party policies: Third-party services may process data outside the website owner's direct control. Their own privacy policies and terms may also apply.
Social media links description: The website may contain links to external social media and messaging services such as Telegram, Instagram and other platforms.
Social media no embed: These links are intended to take you to external websites. Unless explicitly embedded, the external service is not loaded only because a social media link is present on this website.
Legal basis introduction: Depending on the situation, personal data may be processed because it is necessary to provide a service requested by the user, to operate and secure the website, to comply with legal obligations, or on another lawful basis available under applicable law.
Legal basis account: Account information is processed to create and maintain the account requested by the user.
Legal basis order: Order information is processed to communicate with the buyer and to perform actions necessary to process and fulfil the order.
Legal basis analytics: Analytics processing may rely on consent where consent is required by applicable law.
Legal basis cookies: Necessary cookies are used because they are required for basic website functionality and cookie consent management. Optional analytics cookies should be used only where the applicable consent requirements have been satisfied.
Legal basis applicable law: This policy is intended to be understandable for users in Belarus and Russia. The rights, obligations and legal bases applicable to a particular person or processing activity may depend on the law that applies to that situation.
Consent introduction: Where consent is required, it should be voluntary, informed and specific to the relevant processing activity.
Consent necessary cookies: The cookie banner identifies the use of necessary cookies. Necessary cookies cannot be disabled because they are required for the operation of the consent mechanism and basic website functionality.
Consent withdrawal: Because the website currently relies on necessary cookies for the functions covered by this banner, there is no optional cookie category that can currently be withdrawn through the banner.
Consent record: The website stores the user's cookie choice so that the banner does not repeatedly ask for the same choice.
Data sharing introduction: Personal data may be shared with service providers when this is necessary to operate the website or provide a service requested by the user.
Data sharing providers: Technical and service providers such as hosting, authentication, database, analytics, security and performance providers may process relevant information.
Data sharing legal requirement: Information may also be disclosed where required by applicable law, a lawful request from a competent authority, or to protect the rights and security of the website and its users.
Data sharing security: Reasonable technical and organizational measures are used to reduce the risk of unauthorized access, loss or misuse.
Data sharing no sale: Personal data is not intentionally sold to third parties.
Cross border processing description: Some third-party services may process information on servers located outside Belarus or Russia and may therefore involve international data transfers.
Cross border processing safeguards: Where required, the website owner will take reasonable steps to use appropriate contractual, technical or organizational safeguards and to comply with applicable legal requirements.
Data retention introduction: Personal data is kept only for as long as reasonably necessary for the purpose for which it was collected, for legal obligations, dispute resolution, security or other legitimate operational needs.
Data retention account: Account information may be retained while the account is active and for a reasonable period afterwards when necessary for legitimate operational or legal purposes.
Data retention orders: Order information may be retained as long as necessary to process the order, handle related communications, meet legal or accounting requirements and resolve disputes.
Data retention cookies: The nekhay_gdpr consent cookie is retained for up to 400 days unless it is deleted earlier or its configuration is changed.
Your rights introduction: Depending on the law applicable to your situation, you may have rights relating to your personal data, including:
Right information: The right to request information about how your personal data is processed
Right correction: The right to request correction of inaccurate or incomplete data
Right deletion: The right to request deletion of personal data where there is a lawful basis to do so
Right withdraw: The right to withdraw consent where processing is based on consent
Right restriction: The right to request restriction or object to certain processing where applicable
Right complaint: The right to contact the competent data protection or supervisory authority where you believe your rights have been violated
Rights limitations: These rights are not absolute and may be limited by applicable law, including where information must be retained to comply with legal obligations or establish, exercise or defend legal claims.
Data security description: Reasonable technical and organizational measures are used to protect personal data against unauthorized access, loss, alteration, disclosure or destruction.
Data security limitation: No method of storing or transmitting information over the internet can be guaranteed to be completely secure.
Children description: This website is not specifically directed at children. Personal data should not be provided by children where the applicable law requires parental or other lawful consent.
Policy changes description: This policy may be updated when website functionality, data processing activities, cookies, third-party services or applicable legal requirements change.
Policy changes date: The current version is identified by the last updated date shown at the beginning of this page.
